summary: Validate private prompt attention revisions in the authenticated person's projection so real client answers can reach the native provider.

replay.detail: No replicated event or replay changes.

schema.detail: No additional schema or client contract changes.

rules.detail: Attention revision validation uses the authenticated person's view; a foreign private prompt or stale episode revision remains refused.

compatibility.detail: Clients can submit the exact attention revision returned for their own prompt. Snapshot and native incarnation fences are preserved.

downtime.detail: No additional migration or downtime requirement.

manual.detail: No additional manual action beyond installing the prompt source change.

recovery.detail: Existing single-use native response and recorded prompt cleanup rules remain unchanged.
